rubric.SUPPORTED: Evidence is sufficient and every material field value is directly attributable to a cited source record (seed field or source-graph ID).
rubric.PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: Some fields are attributable, but at least one material field is missing, donor-substituted, or deferred; output must carry explicit caveats and UNKNOWNs.
rubric.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Cannot safely produce this output; fields must remain UNKNOWN/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and command fields must be null.
rubric.UNSUPPORTED_FABRICATION_RISK: Producing this output at this level would require guessing, model memory, or unanchored sources; forbidden.
rubric.NOT_APPLICABLE: Not relevant for this action/case (use sparingly; justify).

field_attribution_rule: Each non-UNKNOWN Patch Form field must cite >=1 seed field or source-graph ID. LLM text is never a source. Unanchored/rejected sources (e.g., S255) must never be cited.

metrics_per_level.definition: Counts are retrospective estimates for the 8 UZBL5 Patch Actions, derived from frozen artifacts (not a new execution).

L0.unsupported_fabricated_claim_count: 0 if policy obeyed (abstain); >0 if agent guesses registry/compat
L0.correct_abstention_count: 8/8 should abstain on command/validation_command; version partial

L1.source_provenance_completeness: 136 source records, 97 retrieved, 34 fetch-failed, 1 rejected (S255), 0 missing parents
L1.external_roots: scanner References[] + PrimaryURL/DataSource + runtime TOMCAT_TGZ_FALLBACK_URL (+ deterministic children)
L1.promoted_vs_candidate: all used sources anchored; S255 rejected, S256 failed-unused

L2.supported_field_count: medium+ (advisory confidence added; same commands as L1)
L2.source_provenance_completeness: L1 + advisory records (NVD/OSV/GHSA/KEV); estimate only, not executed
L2.promoted_vs_candidate: advisory refs typed; third-party links candidate-only

L3.correct_abstention_count: 0/8 on artifact grounds (abstention shifts to compat/procedure if L4/L5 absent)
L3.source_provenance_completeness: L1/L2 + 15 replay sources (3 derived roots, 12 retrieved, 0 failed, 0 unparented, valid:true)
L3.promoted_vs_candidate: native-registry POM/JAR/SHA1 promoted as DERIVED_PACKAGE_AUTHORITY; deps.dev R005/R010/R015 candidate-only LOW
L3.validator_readiness: source gate 8/8 passable; validator READY still 5/8 observed (commands for 3 not drafted in replay)

L4.source_provenance_completeness: L3 + promoted upstream docs (projection; partial precedent S004-S007)
L4.promoted_vs_candidate: promotion only via deterministic confidence rules + corroboration

L5.unknown_field_count: minimal (only genuinely unknowable app-smoke behavior deferred downstream)
L5.correct_abstention_count: typed abstention only on true residual gaps
L5.source_provenance_completeness: L4 + runtime-vendor docs from runtime identity (partial precedent S014-S017)
L5.promoted_vs_candidate: vendor docs promoted only when parented to runtime identity/derived URL
L5.validator_readiness: 8/8 per-action passable; run READY requires all-actions-resolved + review

separation_rule.source_coverage: Do cited sources reach every required artifact/dependency/procedure? (L1: 5/8; L3: 8/8 source-reachable)
separation_rule.validator_readiness: Do command + validation_command fields satisfy kalama.remediation codec + confirmations? (L1: 5/8; L3 replay: still 5/8 observed)
separation_rule.remediation_success: Did AFTER scan + re-exploit + behavior checks pass? (never claimed in 7.5.x; downstream stages NOT_STARTED)
